# DNSChecker.space — Complete Technical Reference & AI Agent Documentation

## About DNSChecker
DNSChecker (https://dnschecker.space) is an enterprise-grade cyber-intelligence and network diagnostic web application. It provides real-time lookups across domain names, IP addresses, email servers, and TLS endpoints.

## Tool Directory & Use Cases

### 1. My IP Address Checker (`/my-ip`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/my-ip
- **Target Keywords:** what is my ip, my ip address, check my ip, my ip location, public ip checker, ip lookup
- **Capabilities:**
  - Detects client public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
  - Resolves ISP (Internet Service Provider) and Autonomous System Number (ASN).
  - Displays approximate city, region, country, and timezone.
  - Provides instant copy button for terminal scripting.

### 2. IP Address Lookup (`/lookup`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/lookup
- **Target Keywords:** ip address lookup, trace ip, track ip location, whois ip, reverse ip
- **Capabilities:**
  - Queries arbitrary IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or domain hostnames.
  - Maps location coordinates on an interactive Leaflet map.
  - Detects proxy, VPN, Tor exit node, and cloud hosting datacenter IP ranges.

### 3. DNS Lookup & Propagation (`/dns`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/dns
- **Target Keywords:** dns checker, dns lookup, dns propagation checker, check a record, mx lookup, txt record check
- **Supported Records:**
  - `A`: IPv4 host address.
  - `AAAA`: IPv6 host address.
  - `CNAME`: Canonical alias domain.
  - `MX`: Mail exchange server priority.
  - `NS`: Authoritative nameservers.
  - `TXT`: Text metadata (SPF, domain ownership verification, DKIM).
  - `SOA`: Start of Authority record.
  - `CAA`: Certificate Authority Authorization policy.

### 4. WHOIS Domain Lookup (`/whois`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/whois
- **Target Keywords:** whois lookup, domain whois, domain age checker, domain expiry date, registrar lookup
- **Data Provided:**
  - Registrar name and IANA ID.
  - Creation date, update date, and expiration timestamp.
  - Domain status codes (clientTransferProhibited, serverDeleteProhibited, etc.).
  - DNSSEC validation status.

### 5. SSL/TLS Certificate Checker (`/ssl`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/ssl
- **Target Keywords:** ssl checker, check ssl certificate, tls certificate checker, ssl expiry check, https test
- **Diagnostics:**
  - TLS protocol version negotiation (TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3).
  - Subject Common Name (CN) and Subject Alternative Names (SANs).
  - Full certificate chain trust path to root CA.
  - Days remaining until expiration.

### 6. Security Headers Scanner (`/headers`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/headers
- **Target Keywords:** security headers check, hsts checker, csp scanner, http headers inspection
- **Evaluated Headers:**
  - `Strict-Transport-Security` (HSTS)
  - `Content-Security-Policy` (CSP)
  - `X-Frame-Options` (Clickjacking prevention)
  - `X-Content-Type-Options` (MIME-sniffing prevention)
  - `Referrer-Policy` (Data leakage mitigation)
  - `Permissions-Policy` (Browser feature restriction)

### 7. Blacklist & Threat Reputation (`/blacklist`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/blacklist
- **Target Keywords:** ip blacklist check, spam blacklist check, rbl check, dnsbl lookup, abuseipdb check
- **Database Coverage:**
  - Queries 50+ real-time DNSBL / RBL spam databases.
  - Flags IPs associated with brute-force SSH attacks, spam relays, and malware C2 servers.

### 8. Email Security & SPF/DKIM/DMARC (`/email`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/email
- **Target Keywords:** email checker, spf checker, dkim checker, dmarc lookup, disposable email test
- **Verification:**
  - RFC 5322 syntax validation.
  - MX server connectivity.
  - SPF record syntax (`v=spf1 ...`).
  - DMARC policy enforcement (`p=reject`, `p=quarantine`, `p=none`).
  - Disposable temporary inbox detection.

### 9. Port Scanner (`/ports`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/ports
- **Target Keywords:** port checker, open port scanner, test open ports, port 80 check, port 443 check, minecraft port check
- **Probed Ports:**
  - Port 80 (HTTP)
  - Port 443 (HTTPS)
  - Port 22 (SSH)
  - Port 21 (FTP)
  - Port 25 (SMTP)
  - Port 3306 (MySQL)
  - Port 3389 (RDP)
  - Port 25565 (Minecraft Java)

### 10. IP Geolocation (`/geo`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/geo
- **Target Keywords:** ip geolocation, geo ip lookup, find ip country, city from ip
- **Output:** Accurate country, state/province, city, postal code, latitude, and longitude.

### 11. Hosting Provider Lookup (`/hosting`)
- **URL:** https://dnschecker.space/hosting
- **Target Keywords:** hosting checker, who is hosting this website, server host lookup, asn lookup
- **Output:** Hosting company, ASN number, organization name, and datacenter location.

## API & Terminal Query Examples

### Check Public IP via CMD / Terminal
```bash
# Public IPv4 lookup
curl -4 https://dnschecker.space/my-ip

# Local LAN IP (Windows CMD)
ipconfig

# Local LAN IP (Linux/macOS)
ip a || ifconfig
```

### Flush DNS Resolver Cache
```bash
# Windows (CMD / PowerShell)
ipconfig /flushdns

# macOS
sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder

# Linux (systemd-resolved)
sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches
```

## Schema & Structured Data Architecture
- Every page emits Schema.org `WebApplication` or `SoftwareApplication`.
- Every page emits Schema.org `BreadcrumbList`.
- All tool and homepage views emit Schema.org `FAQPage` rich snippet data.
- Global `WebSite` schema specifies search capability.
- Global `Organization` schema provides publisher verification and brand authority.
